title: SCE symbol lookup record (wire schema v1)
description: One resolved symbol emitted by a sourcemap lookup. Both directions share this shape and are distinguished by `kind`: `addr2sce` resolves a mangled symbol to the SCXML coordinates it came from, `sce2sym` resolves SCXML coordinates to the symbols they lowered to. Emitted as NDJSON — one record per line, one line per hit — because a single SCXML coordinate legitimately lowers to several symbols, and a lookup may span several backends' sidecars in one invocation. Authoritative producer is sce-build/src/forge/sourcemap.rs; the symbol table itself is schemas/sce-sourcemap.v1.schema.json. Consumers MUST ignore unknown fields. The stability status of this surface lives in this header alone — see SCE_WIRE_CONTRACTS.md.

v.description: Record schema version. Always 1 for this revision.

kind.description: Which direction produced this record. Kept in lockstep with the Rust LookupKind enum.

sourcemap.description: Path of the sce_sourcemap.json this hit came from. Named per record so a lookup spanning several backends stays attributable without correlating by position.

symbol.description: Mangled symbol name — the key under `symbols` in the sourcemap.

entry.description: The symbol's row from the sourcemap, verbatim. Shape is `sourceSymbol` in schemas/sce-sourcemap.v1.schema.json.

scxml_file.description: Author-facing path to the SCXML file the symbol traces back to.

scxml_state_path.description: Canonical state-hierarchy path. Empty for the per-machine symbol and for forge-kind body symbols.

scxml_xpath.description: Best-effort XPath approximation synthesised from the state path.

line_range.description: [start, end] 1-based line range, inclusive at both ends.

event.description: Event name for transition / raise / send symbols.

wcet_us.description: Worst-case execution-time hint in microseconds, when a profiler consumer injected one.
